title: Configure plex
description: Configure the Plex Media Server module

host.title: Host name
host.description: Fully qualified domain name under which Plex is published.

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate for the host name.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all HTTP requests to HTTPS.

network_mode.title: Network mode
network_mode.description: bridge: only the web/API port is published on the node loopback and fronted by Traefik. host: the container shares the node network (32400 plus the GDM/DLNA discovery ports directly on the node IP); only one such instance per node.

media_paths.title: Media paths
media_paths.description: Absolute host paths of the media libraries (iSCSI/NFS mounts, ...). Each is mounted read-only at the same path inside the container.

media_require_mount.title: Require mounted filesystem
media_require_mount.description: Refuse to start Plex when a media path is not on a mounted filesystem (protects the libraries from a scan against an empty directory).

hw_transcoding.title: Hardware transcoding
hw_transcoding.description: Pass /dev/dri (Intel/AMD GPU) into the container. Requires Plex Pass and read/write access of the module user to the render device.

plex_claim.title: Claim token
plex_claim.description: One-time token from https://www.plex.tv/claim that links the server to your Plex account at the next start. Valid for 4 minutes; ignored once the server is claimed.
